description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, you can read and understand Sakvroth, and any creature who listens to you speak or communicates with you telepathically hears your words magically translated into Sakvroth, regardless of what language you're speaking. This effect prevents you from communicating in any language other than Sakvroth, but you can Dismiss the effect at any time. While the effect lasts, you gain a +2 status bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks to influence serpentfolk.
